description: This file defines an Android activity class SaveRestoreState that demonstrates saving and restoring activity state, particularly focused on handling text in an EditText widget. It includes lifecycle management via onCreate and methods to get and set text content.

classes.name: SaveRestoreState
classes.description: An Android activity for demonstrating saving and restoring the state of a UI component, specifically an EditText widget.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and updates a TextView with a message.

methods.name: getSavedText
methods.description: Returns the current text from the 'saved' EditText.

methods.name: setSavedText
methods.description: Sets the specified text into the 'saved' EditText.

search-terms: Android activity state save and restore
